claims.explanation: GW-441756 is a selective TrkA (NTRK1) inhibitor, so sensitivity is most plausibly driven by dependence on NGF/TrkA autocrine or paracrine signaling, which is characteristic of neural-crest-derived tumors such as melanoma and neuroblastoma. The selectively killed set is enriched for melanomas, neuroblastomas, and RAS/MAPK-pathway-mutant lines, whereas the resistant set is dominated by gastrointestinal, pancreatic, and Ewing sarcoma lines with low neurotrophic receptor dependence. NTRK1 expression and downstream MAPK activation should therefore predict sensitivity, while low NTRK1/NGF expression predicts protection.

features.basis: GW-441756 is a selective TrkA/NTRK1 inhibitor; TrkA-expressing tumors depend on NGF signaling (PMID 27145455, 31788928)
NGF ligand drives TrkA activation and autocrine/paracrine survival signaling in responsive tumors (PMID 27145455, 33466524)
Melanoma lines with BRAF mutations are enriched among the most killed lines, consistent with MAPK-pathway dependence
RAS-mutant neural-crest lines (e.g., SKNSH neuroblastoma) are among the most killed, suggesting MAPK-driven survival
KRAS-mutant neuroblastoma and some NSCLC lines are killed, though KRAS alone is not sufficient given resistant KRAS-mutant colorectal/pancreatic lines
MAP2K1-mutant NCIH1437 is among the most killed lines, consistent with MAPK-pathway addiction
ALK-mutant neuroblastoma (KELLY) and mesothelioma (NCIH2452) lines are among the least affected, suggesting ALK bypasses TrkA dependence
PTEN loss appears in several killed breast/skin lines, possibly reflecting PI3K/AKT co-dependence with TrkA signaling
TP53 mutation is common in both killed and resistant lines, so it is not a strong predictor; listed only as a weak negative association
CDKN2A loss is frequent in killed melanoma and neuroblastoma lines, but also in resistant lines, so weak evidence
ARID1A mutations appear in several resistant lines (GP2D, SUIT2, EFE184), suggesting chromatin-remodeling loss may reduce TrkA dependence
SF3B1 mutations appear in resistant colorectal/esophageal lines and one killed kidney line, so weak and inconsistent evidence
